cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You waved everyone out of the shop, so I've waved you over here. Wait by the till until I wave you off.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was waving to my daughter outside. The till's counted; we're ready to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, the family signal. Bring her in; I'll release you together once I've checked the cash.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Our taxi's here. She's holding the door for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll give the signal from the pavement. Wait beside the open door until you see my hand go up.

reason: Copy an ordinary farewell gesture as dismissal authority; B transport pressure moves but does not remove A claimed permission.
